title: TOF: off-delay timer
summary: TOF switches Q on immediately with IN and keeps it on for the preset time PT after IN goes off.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.body:
- When **IN** becomes TRUE, **Q** becomes TRUE at once and ET is 0.
- When IN becomes FALSE, ET starts counting while Q stays TRUE.
- When ET reaches **PT**, Q becomes FALSE.
- If IN becomes TRUE again before PT elapses, ET resets and Q stays TRUE.

sections.heading: Typical use
sections.body: Fan run-on after a heater switches off, keeping a conveyor running until the last part has left, or bridging short signal drop-outs from a sensor.

outputs.name: Q
outputs.description: TRUE while IN is TRUE and for PT afterwards

instruction.state: Instance holds the falling-edge time and output state.
instruction.timing: Evaluated once per call; resolution equals the cycle time in PLC Lab.
